description: File feedback for the AHOOK team as a support ticket: a feature request, a bug, something confusing, or anything else. A human reviews every filing; nothing is auto-built from it. Limited to 6 filings per day. Returns the ticket id and a public status URL.

callback_url.description: An https URL to notify when the feedback is reviewed or resolved. Must be a public https URL; private or internal URLs are rejected (platform-wide internal-URL block).

error.description: The error text or message the agent hit, if the feedback is about an error.

kind.description: The kind of feedback. Defaults to feature_request.

property.description: The property slug (for example "main-landing") or group id. Under a PAP session it defaults to the session's property and cannot be overridden. With a bare account key it is required.

session_id.description: The agent's session id, if it has one.

text.description: The feedback, bug report, or feature request, in your own words. Required. Maximum 2000 characters.

tool_name.description: The MCP tool the feedback is about, if any.

name: submit_feedback
